project_context: Hybrid Fullstack POS (Point of Sale) Billing System for Grocery Shop with Telugu UI.

hierarchy.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 (Use Noto Sans Telugu)
hierarchy.numbers: font-mono or IBM Plex Sans for prices, quantities, and shortcut codes (a1, b2).

visual_enhancers.borders_and_radii: Use subtle roundness (rounded-md to rounded-lg max). Sharp edges for nested tables/grids.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. shadow-sm on cards, shadow-md on dropdowns/modals. Avoid heavy shadows to maintain a flat, fast POS look.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse for high-density item tables.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) - POS Layout
grids_and_layouts.main_layout: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-screen p-4 overflow-hidden
grids_and_layouts.left_panel: lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col gap-4 h-full (Search, Shortcut Input, Quick Items Grid)
grids_and_layouts.right_panel: lg:col-span-4 flex flex-col bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm h-full (Running Bill, Khata, Checkout)
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tight spacing (p-2, p-3, p-4) to maximize vertical space for items. Use flex-1 overflow-y-auto for lists.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-semibold transition-colors active:scale-95
buttons.checkout: w-full bg-emerald-600 text-white py-4 rounded-md text-xl font-bold shadow-sm

inputs.search: w-full text-lg p-3 border-2 border-slate-300 rounded-md focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-100 transition-all font-mono for shortcuts

tables.billing: w-full text-left border-collapse. th: text-xs uppercase bg-slate-100 p-2 border-b. td: p-2 border-b text-sm font-medium.

cards.khata: border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4 rounded-lg flex justify-between items-center

motion.details: POS systems require speed. Avoid long animations. Use scale-95 on button clicks, and fast hover transitions (duration-150).

accessibility_and_interactions.keyboard_first: CRITICAL. Must be fully operable via keyboard. Enter to add item, Up/Down to navigate lists, specific hotkeys (e.g., F2 for Pay, F3 for Khata) if feasible.
accessibility_and_interactions.shortcuts: Main input should parse shortcodes (e.g., 'a1', 'b2') and instantly map them to grocery items like 'Butter' (వెన్న) in the backend/state.
accessibility_and_interactions.test_ids: Include standard data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pos-search-input', data-testid='checkout-btn').

media_and_icons.usage: Use icons for clear actions (Trash2 for delete item, Printer for print receipt, FileSpreadsheet for CSV upload).

transliteration.instruction: Wrap main input fields with <ReactTransliterate> configured for language='te' (Telugu). This allows users to type 'venna' and output 'వెన్న'.

csv_import.instruction: Use standard HTML <input type='file' accept='.csv' /> and parse using a library like Papaparse (yarn add papaparse). Show a diff/preview table before confirming.

print_css.instruction: Create a thermal receipt layout hidden by default, visible only in @media print. Apply .print:hidden to the main POS UI and .print:block to the receipt div. Width should be constrained for 80mm thermal printers (max-w-[300px]).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic centered layouts. This is a high-density POS system, left-align lists and right-align prices/numbers.
Do not apply global 'transition: all' as it breaks performance. Use specific transitions.
Use solid colors, no generic gradients. The interface must be high-contrast and readable under bright shop lights.
Ensure 'react-transliterate' is installed and used for all manual text entries to support seamless English-to-Telugu typing.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., 'Prices Updated Successfully', 'Bill Settled').
For Khata (credit ledgers), use warning colors (Amber) to denote unpaid balances.
Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
